# netbox_vlan_translation_policy (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox vlan translation policy (`/api/ipam/vlan-translation-policies/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_vlan_translation_policy" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_vlan_translation_policy" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/ipam/vlan-translation-policies/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `rule_ids` (Set of Number) Rules. References `netbox_vlan_translation_rule`.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
